A giant star, about 30 million light-years from Earth, has been “exploding” roughly every 113 days, and astronomers have been watching it do this for 15 years.
Data from Using NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory finally reveals the culprit: a hidden companion that’s either a black hole or a neutron star, taking a bite out of the star each time they swing close together.
